v2 ## ANDHRA PRADESH LEGISLATIVE COUNCIL SESSION-46 L.C.Q.No.13609 (Starred) Given notice by Sri Duvvada Srinivas Sri Tumati Madhava Rao Sri Rajagolla Ramesh Yadav M.L.Cs. Will the Hon’ble Minister for Excise be pleased to state: (a) Whether it is a fact that the State Government has introduced a New Liquor Policy in the State; (b) Whether the price of liquor has been reduced under the new liquor policy; (c) If so, the brand-wise details of the same; and (d) If not, the reasons thereof ? ## REVENUE (EXCISE) DEPARTMENT ## ANSWER a) Yes Sir. b) Yes Sir, a new segment of good quality affordable liquor @ Rs.99 for 180 ml has been introduced as per new Excise Policy. c) The following liquor brands of 180 ml were introduced in low priced MRP:
Name of the Supplier Name of the Brand MRP
M/s ALLIED BLENDERS & Distillers Limited SUMO CLASSIC WHISKY 99
M/s JOHN DISTILLERIES PVT.LTD., BANGALORE WHISKY 99
M/s RADICO KHAITAN LIMITED ROYAL LANCER WHISKY 99
M/s RADICO KHAITAN LIMITED TROPICANA VSOP BRANDY 99
M/S Tilaknagar Industries Ltd SHOT WHISKY 99
M/s. Radico Khaitan Ltd BRANDY 99 99
S/L M/s.Brindavan Marketing Agencies (In
Brew)		 KERALA MALTED FINE
WHISKY		 99
d) For all other categories of liquor Tender Committee is being constituted to align MRPs with neighbouring States. (THE ABOVE ANSWER HAS BEEN APPROVED BY THE HON'BLE MINISTER FOR EXCISE) for Principal Secretary to Government To The Andhra Pradesh Legislative Council. (150 copies each English and Telugu) P.T.O.
